errors.text_span: Es gibt zwei separate Balkendiagramme auf dem Bild
errors.evidence: The figure is a single bar chart with one shared x-axis; it is not two separate bar charts.

The category labels are on the y-axis (vertical placement of categories in a horizontal bar chart), but the description incorrectly refers to them as vertical axes and implies two separate vertical axes.
The Gastgewerbe bar is approximately 48%, not 47%.
The Baugewerbe bar is approximately 9%, not 5%.
The bar for Größere Betriebe (250+) is approximately 36%, not 38%.
The bar for Kleinstbetriebe (1-9) is approximately 19%, not 17%.
The description does not mention the x-axis tick interval explicitly (0, 5, 10, ... 50) or that the scale is linear.
The description does not note that the bars are sorted in descending order across the full list of categories, which is a visible structural feature requested by the prompt.
